actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.shared.ChatterServices.get#Timeline').parameters({recordEntityName: recordEntity || '', recordId: recordId || '', kinds: kinds || null, beforeDate: beforeDate || null, seenKeys: seenKeys || null, pageSize: pageSize || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {entryList: out.entryList, hasMore: out.hasMore, nextBeforeDate: out.nextBeforeDate, nextSeenKeys: out.nextSeenKeys, failedSources: out.failedSources})
const list = (found && found.optionList) || [] ec.web.sendJsonResponse(list.map((row) => ({id: row.recordId, label: row.label, entity: row.recordEntityName})))
ec.web.sendJsonResponse(found.userList || [])
ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : (cardOut.card || {}))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.shared.ChatterServices.log#Note').parameters({recordEntityName: recordEntity, recordId: recordId, body: body, recordUrl: recordUrl || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {communicationEventId: out.communicationEventId, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message}]})

const forClient = !!ec.user.userId && ec.user.hasPermission('PROJECT_CLIENT') const out = forClient ? ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.client.ClientServices.send#ChatterMessage').parameters({recordEntityName: recordEntity, recordId: recordId, subject: subject || null, body: body, recordUrl: recordUrl || null}).call() : ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.shared.ChatterServices.send#Message').parameters({recordEntityName: recordEntity, recordId: recordId, toUserIds: toUserIds || null, subject: subject || null, body: body, recordUrl: recordUrl || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {communicationEventId: out.communicationEventId, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.shared.ChatterServices.unlink#Entry').parameters({recordEntityName: recordEntity, recordId: recordId, communicationEventId: communicationEventId}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {unlinked: out.unlinked, messageInfos: [{type: out.unlinked ? 'success' : 'warning', message: out.message}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.shared.ChatterServices.schedule#Activity').parameters({recordEntityName: recordEntity, recordId: recordId, activityType: activityType, workEffortName: workEffortName, dueDate: dueDate || null, endDate: endDate || null, assignToPartyId: assignToPartyId || null, description: description || null, recordUrl: recordUrl || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {workEffortId: out.workEffortId, url: out.url, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message, link: out.url}]})

const next = scheduleNext === 'Y' const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.shared.ChatterServices.complete#Activity').parameters({recordEntityName: recordEntity, recordId: recordId, workEffortId: workEffortId, feedback: feedback || null, nextActivityType: next ? (nextActivityType || null) : null, nextName: next ? (nextName || null) : null, nextDueDate: next ? (nextDueDate || null) : null, recordUrl: recordUrl || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {communicationEventId: out.communicationEventId, nextWorkEffortId: out.nextWorkEffortId, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.shared.ChatterServices.update#Activity').parameters({recordEntityName: recordEntity, recordId: recordId, workEffortId: workEffortId, workEffortName: workEffortName, dueDate: dueDate || null, endDate: endDate || null, description: description || null, assignToPartyId: assignToPartyId || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message}]})
